messages:
jamal: FYI I opened PR #312 to refresh the SampleKit onboarding. Goals: streamline the hello app, clarify auth env var, add a tiny Docker deploy, and include a short Go snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/312
marie: thanks — will take a look. can we keep the Python snippet minimal (single-file example) and add a note about SDK version compatibility? :+1:
sara: one urgent note: env var name changed to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in SDK v7+. please update any `API_KEY` references. also prefer `Authorization: Bearer <key>` examples over older header forms.
jamal: good catch, sara. i'll sweep for `API_KEY` instances and replace. tagging marie for the SDK compatibility blurb.
docs-bot: preview build queued for PR #312 — preview URL will follow when ready.
alex: quick UX nits after a skim: 1) move the Docker snippet closer to the deploy paragraph so users see it earlier, 2) add a one-line troubleshooting note about CORS for local dev.
marie: i pushed a short Go snippet to the PR comment that matches our new client API, example:```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, redwood.GenerateParams{Prompt: "hello"})
```
jamal: awesome, marie — can you also add the single-file Python minimal example? i'll insert it into the quickstart.
marie: added Python single-file example to the README diff:```python
from redwood import Client
import os
client = Client(os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
print(client.generate("hello"))
```
jamal: thanks. i pushed the auth env var fixes and swapped the Docker section per alex. Docker snippet is tiny:```Dockerfile
FROM python:3.11-slim
COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app
RUN pip install -r requirements.txt
CMD ["python", "app.py"]
```
docs-bot: preview build started for PR #312 — https://deploy-preview-312.docs.redwood.ai/preview
deploy-bot: preview build failed — error: broken link in /getting-started/samplekit.md: ./old-snippets/hello.md (404)
jamal: ah — forgot to delete a cross-ref. fixing paths now.
jamal: pushed path fix — removed the old-snippets link and updated to /examples/samplekit/hello.md
docs-bot: preview ready — https://deploy-preview-312.docs.redwood.ai/preview (diff: updated quickstart, auth, Docker, Go/Python snippets)
marie: skimmed preview — looks good. wording tweak: change "set your key" to "export REDWOOD_API_KEY in your shell" so it's explicit.
alex: LGTM after that micro-text change. also please squash the doc commits into a single commit for the merge commit history.
jamal: will squash and merge once CI passes. thanks everyone for quick turnaround :rocket:
docs-bot: CI checks passed for PR #312.
jamal: merged PR #312 and filed a follow-up issue for an expanded troubleshooting appendix (ISSUE #88). closing thread. :tada:
